name: Izumi Sada
source:
AGE: 22
HEIGHT: 160cm
BORN: February 2
WEIGHT: 53*kg
NATIONALITY: Japanese
WEAKNESS: Vanity

[i]“When life seems to bear nothing but sour and bitter lemons, sometimes all you need is a dash of sugar to bring out the deliciousness hidden in the fruit.”[/i]

Izumi Sada is the World☆Class Psychologist, a young woman who proudly employs her skills to help others going through some of the roughest times of their lives. She understands what it’s like to feel pressured by society when life isn’t going as you’d hoped. But she also knows all it takes is a single life-altering breakthrough for everything that was once muddied to become crystal clear. There’s so much more to Izumi than her World☆Class skills: she’s someone with dreams of starting a family, and she’s finally met her perfect match in the World☆Class Idol.

Likes: Kawaii, freshness, purity, helping others
Dislikes: Ghosts, un-cute things, lies, sweating
